text:
Alex: Quick low-stakes poll — who keeps liberating the Earl Grey teabags? Drop a one-word confession. No judgment, just tea. :tea:
Maria: Guilty (EarlGrey). I will accept responsibility and biscuits. :sweat_smile:
Jamie: stealth. (I whisper when I approach the pantry) :ghost:
Sam: vending-machine. totally not me. :mic_drop:  
Kelly: sorry — I thought they were communal. one-word: apologies. :purple_heart:
Peggy Bot: Heads-up: kitchen supplies are shared resources. If you label items with your initials we can avoid future heists. 
Alex: New plan: emergency peppermint stash hidden behind the coffee filters. First finder wins eternal office bragging rights. :trophy:
Maria: Found it. Bragging initiated. Claiming throne of peppermint. :crown:
Jamie: One-liner submission: "If lost, return to mug." :coffee:
Sam: My one-liner: "Stealthy tea, loud kettle." :loud_sound:
Kelly: Vote poll: favorite tea — 1) Earl Grey 2) English Breakfast 3) Chamomile. Reply with the number.
Alex: 1
Maria: 1
Jamie: 2
Sam: 3
Kelly: 1
Alex: Summary: Earl Grey wins by a landslide. Next steps: label personal boxes, Kelly brings biscuits Friday, and Maria gets honorary peppermint crown. :cookie: :crown:
